title: Practical Experience
text: “Dragging Lord Iwatani into this… I’m so dumbfounded I’m speechless. Lord Kitamura, do you really want to see naked women that badly?”
“I just want to see Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan. Looking at pigs just makes me want to puke. Pfft!”

Éclair is staring at me with half-closed eyes. Looking closely, I see she’s covering herself with a towel. Yuki-chan seems to be doing the same. There were two Demi-Human pigs at the other hot spring, and they were doing the same thing. As for Sakura-chan… she’s dozing off at the edge of the hot spring in her Filolial Queen form.
“Since you declared you’d be peeping so brazenly, I had everything prepared in advance—even though there weren’t any bathers to begin with.”
“Well, Motoyasu-sama? Has my charm increased now?”
“Soak in the tub a little more seductively.”
“Criticism? Motoyasu-kun, you really are something else…”

To become a proper lady, it’s sometimes necessary to polish one’s charm. Though Filo-tan is already brimming with charm from the start. That airheaded charm is her greatest asset. However, I haven’t fallen so low as to think everyone must be just like Filo-tan. I love everyone dearly and shower them with affection! That’s right… Filolial-sama is equally my daughter and son.
After that, Éclair seemed to give up and stopped interfering with my peeping, so she got into the bath. I, too, turned my gaze back to the men’s bath and soaked myself.
“Phew… I’ve had a rough time getting dragged into this by Motoyasu-kun.”
“You’re so naive, Father.”
“I’m fine being naive! Sure, peeking into the women’s bath is a dream, but you’re supposed to do it more quietly!”
“Lord Iwatani?”
Éclair is speaking in a tone that sounds like she’s grilling him. Perhaps flustered by the question, Father fired off a new remark.
“I’m not peeping! I’m just talking about what’s common sense—or rather, a rite of passage—in my world.”
“…I suppose so. Mr. Iwatani, please warn Mr. Kitamura: as long as he doesn’t get caught… well, it won’t be a big deal. I’m honestly tired of constantly having to warn Mr. Kitamura about everything.”
I can hear the sound of Éclair sighing as she sinks back into the bath.
“So, Motoyasu-kun, peeping isn’t something you’re supposed to do. If you just soothe your eyes by looking at her flushed figure after she gets out of the bath, you can get excited legally.”
“That’s a teasing tactic, isn’t it?”
“Huh? Umm… isn’t that kind of off?”
“But then I won’t be able to admire her naked body.”
“That’s why—that sort of thing… it’s enough to wait until you’re in a special relationship, like boyfriend and girlfriend, or husband and wife.”
“We’re already in a special relationship.”
“Huh?”
“Filolial-sama and his devotee… there’s no closer relationship than this.”
My Father slumped his shoulders as if he’d given up, didn’t he?
“Sorry, Ms. Eclair. I don’t think I can convince Motoyasu-kun.”
“No, Lord Iwatani, you’ve already said enough. Get some rest. I’m going to soothe my tired body, too.”
Somehow, I feel like our bond has grown stronger from soaking in the hot springs. That’s the power of peeping! Peeping actually strengthens our bond.
“Um, getting back to the topic at hand—no matter how many Skills I learn, I still can’t actually master Magic, right?”
“That’s correct. If you simply want to learn a single spell, you can do so by purchasing an expensive Crystal Ball from a magic shop.”
“But doesn’t that mean I won’t be able to understand Magic deeply?”

“That’s absolutely correct. Indeed, when you learn Magic from a Crystal Ball, it falls short in various ways—not only in terms of the Magic Power and the Magical Power it consumes, but also in terms of control and other aspects.”

I, too, took the easy way out at first and learned Magic from a Crystal Ball. However, my Father eventually taught me how to learn Magic from Magic Books, and I came to realize the many benefits of that approach. It’s a classic example of how, if you always take the easy way out, it eventually comes back to bite you.
“But to learn magic, I’ll have to learn this world’s script and decipher the Magic Books…”
I nodded silently. It’s difficult, but it’s not impossible. After all, Father, I, and all the heroes have managed to do it.
“Compared to how smoothly my level, Skills, and weapon enhancements have been progressing so far, this seems to require a lot of tedious steps, doesn’t it?”
“That can’t be helped.”
“Learning Magic sounds incredibly romantic, but I guess it’s not something you can master overnight…”
“You just need to learn it little by little. My future Father seems to have picked it up surprisingly quickly, after all.”
“How long did it take?”
“It seems he was already able to use them by the time he got past the second wave.”
“So that’s about two and a half months… Looks like I’ve got a long road ahead of me.”
Muttering things like that, my future Father dipped his hand into the bathtub and started squirting water. He’s actually pretty good at it. The water is flying quite high.
“Whoa! Iwatani! How do you do that?”

“Here’s how you do it. Use your hand to make a small opening for the hot water to escape… Shape your hand into a tiny hole, like you’re taking a sip and spitting it out. Then, compress the hot water in the palm of your hand and let it out…”
“With my hand…”
Kou tried clumsily to make water come out, but failed.
“It’s hard!”
“You’ll get the hang of it in no time. I wonder if Magic works like this, too.”
“Once you can read and get a feel for Magical Power, you’ll be able to do it.”

Um… if I recall correctly, to master Liberation, I had to learn the Way of the Dragon Vein—a lineage of magic that requires the protection of dragons. This Motoyasu—it’s a type of magic I wouldn’t have wanted to learn if it weren’t for my Father’s orders. But it’s also true that learning it, even reluctantly, has helped me out in many ways.
“It looks like we’re getting pretty close to Siltvelt, so once we’ve ensured our safety, let’s take our time leveling up, study Magic, and then take on the waves, okay?”
“Yeah. Kou, I’ll do my best!”
“Yes, sir.”

Just as I said that, something came flying toward us at high speed. I tried to dash out to protect my Father, but I was just a split second too late. With a splash, the bathwater churned violently in response to my movement. The Siltvelt envoy, who had been quietly accompanying us, slipped and fell in the tub.
“Is Father all right?”
“Hm?”

I managed to deflect most of it, but one hit Father. He’s looking at whatever it was that bounced off him. Judging by its shape… could it be a thorn? It also looks like a blow dart. With a thud, a group of suspicious-looking figures leaped over the hedge.
“You’re paralyzed by poison and can’t move! Demon of the Shield! Brace yourself!”
My father sprang to his feet with a splash and thrust his shield forward. I speared the fool who had recklessly charged at us. Kou transformed into his King form and kicked with all his might.
“They’re back?”
It seems that earlier attack was actually from these guys. But judging by Father’s reaction, could it be…?
“Father, show them just how much stronger you’ve become!”
“Huh? Is everything okay now?”
“What are you talking about now?”
“Openings!”

Seeing me standing there silently, an assassin seized the opportunity and lunged at Father with his sword. On the spot, my father raised his shield, but perhaps due to a lack of experience… his reaction was slightly delayed, and the assassin dodged to the side, attempting to slash his torso. Sparks flew from my father’s body with a sizzle.
“Um…”
“Demon of the Shield! This is the finishing blow!”

My Father held out his hand toward the assassin’s raised sword and caught it between his fingers. Just like that, the sword was pinned between his fingers before it could slice through his flesh, and it stopped dead in its tracks.
“W-what! Damn it! I can’t pull it out!”
“When I focused on it, it looked really slow, and his voice sounded slow, too. Is this the difference that comes with being enhanced?”
“That’s right!”

It seems the assassin is now completely unable to inflict even a single scratch on my Father. To tell you the truth, my Father has been experimenting with every weapon-enhancement method I know. It appears that a mere amateur assassin can no longer even leave a mark on him. HAHAHA! You really can’t compare him to the Father he used to be.
“Y-you monster!”
“Father’s defense test is over. You should be grateful for your own foolishness and for Father’s mercy.”
I hooked the assassin’s collar onto my spear, swung him around vigorously, and hurled him high into the sky.
“Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“If this teaches you a lesson, don’t do anything foolish again!　Hahahahaha!”
“If enemies like this are going to show up… we’d better get a move on. Ms. Éclair! Are you okay over there?”
Just as we were talking, Éclair—sword in hand—climbed over the hedge alongside Yuki-chan.
“I heard a noise. Did something happen?”
“Yeah. Looks like the assassins have already shown up…”
“I’m sorry for the repeated disturbances. I think it won’t be long before our country’s guards can drive out those members of the Three Heroes Church…”
“Hmm… Well, the people in Siltvelt are responding quickly as well. Even if there are people keeping a close watch, they might still manage to get past.”
“But that’s strange. Because of the incident with the Spear Hero, security was supposed to be tight… This inn was also supposed to have extra security provided by the Demi-Humans.”
The envoy from Siltvelt is tilting his head. Hmm, it seems there’s a complex conspiracy lurking beneath the surface. Perhaps we won’t find a place of rest until we reach a safe location.
“I threw him aside for now. He’s lying outside the bathhouse, so I think we should tie him up and make him confess.”
“I see. I’m glad nothing serious happened.”
“I could really feel my level going up and my enhancements paying off.”
“That’s good. If the assassins give up because they can’t take us down, we can continue our journey with peace of mind.”

And so, we left the hot springs. Incidentally, it became clear the next day that the reason the enemies were able to reach the hot springs was… because the Three Heroes Church wasn’t the only enemy out there.
